## Proposed change
<!--

  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the

When a MQTT disabled entity is enabled, after 30 seconds this triggers reloading the MQTT config entry. During unload `await hass.async_block_till_done()` was called after the platform components where unloaded. This was causing a deadlock. Removing the statement does not seem to cause issues.

Some questions:
- When does this happen?
- Can you help with steps how to reproduce this?
- Can you give us the configuration for an entity to do reproduce this?

Same happend this week: (no debug level set, so nothing in my logs)

Go to a device in the mqtt integration that have a disabled entity.
Enable that entity.
Check entities in mqtt integration: all became unavailable.
Reload integration doesn't fix, restart home assistant does.

Core: 2023.3.4, python 3.11, ubuntu 22.04
Everything is correct and described point by point in the post above
I have the same error when activating a disabled object in mqtt

I see this in the log:
```log
2023-03-18 18:19:37.015 INFO (MainThread) [homeassistant.config_entries] Reloading configuration entries because disabled_by changed in entity registry: 6e98ccdd4b264243ef58f3b2abf00a58
```
Some how a reload of config entries is triggered through the entity change but the MQTT config entry does not succeed in reloading. The unsubscribes happen because the MQTT is closing down to reload.

If the config entry is reloaded normally there is no problem.

I found out what is causing the regression:
During unloading the MQTT entry `await hass.async_block_till_done()` is called. Perhaps we should not call this here. If this is also called when awaiting the reloading of config entries, that might cause a deadlock.
Linked PR should resolve the issue. I could reproduce it and after the change the entry reload is done correctly when a disabled entity is enabled.

review_comments: If you want to be extra safe you could replace it with a `await asyncio.sleep(0)` to yield to the event loop and allow anything to finish
